notes.content:

[h1][b]What's up, partygoers![/b][/h1]

[i][b]Party Hard 2[/b][/i] has received a big content update featuring not one but [b]TWO[/b] new levels. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28597375/3a9d29218f1078ba802e3696aadbc3c8631a6ec7.gif[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28597375/354cfd2960fa470581a70a12a0175fc483d50393.gif[/img][h2][b]🚀 Moon[/b][/h2]

[hr][/hr]

Another free bonus level hits the scene! This level is rich with hidden environmental story details that reveal the deep lore of our beloved character, Frogger, and his homeland. Prepare for a trippy experience, uncovering secrets hidden within the game's most mysterious setting yet.

[hr][/hr]
By the way, [i][b]Party Hard 2[/b][/i] is [b]80% off[/b] until April 24th! Pick it up now:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/572430/Party_Hard_2/

Remember that you can gift the game to a friend and play together if you already own it.

notes.title: Introducing Working Hard: Steam devblog
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9581242/1a6f710f23343b01512e437800835c0c18caacaf.png[/img]

[h1][b]Hello, fawkes![/b][/h1]

For the past several months we have been working (hard, of course) on the Party Hard sequel, seeing no light of day. Our only food was bread and our only drink was water ("Dunkel" 4.7° lager, that is). Ignorant of what time of the year it was and whether or not battle royales were still popular, a band of code recluses called Pinokl (us) has been learning everything about elbow grease the [b]hard[/b] way. Until one day the man came around and wrote this: 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9581242/911fe01bb9464be80606b1b72a8ad57168c3496c.png[/img]

Should we say how these seven words and two question marks changed our worldview? After all those months of community silence, it was a one eye-opening experience indeed. [b]Therefore, it is time to straighten up and announce the new Steam community-exclusive developer blog: Working Hard![/b]

In WH, we will be–starting tomorrow–telling you about different features we added/are adding/will add to [i]Party Hard 2[/i], be it mechanics, characters or levels. All to keep you updated on the game's progress. 

[b]Don't forget to add [i]Party Hard 2[/i] to your wishlist and follow the community to get the latest news:[/b]
http://store.steampowered.com/app/572430/Party_Hard_2/

notes.title: Darius's Changelog: Bug fixes
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9581242/b27e14b72992131785e73e6344224bd69f2dfe37.gif[/img]

[h1] PartyHard v1.4.031; 17 Jul 2017, 2:59 a.m.[/h1]

[h1] [b] Dear Log![/b][/h1]

[b] It's Darius again. They stopped him. Finally. Should I say "fixed" instead? Nonetheless, he won't take a life anymore. Just listen to me and you will understand. [/b]

1. That police officer in the Porn Studio... (I'm talking about [i] High Crimes[/i] DLC level) So, you take out everyone—every single shnockered punk—, the victory over everlasting party insanity is within your reach; you are just about to leave... and but a second away that cop takes you down brutally. While he absolutely shouldn't! It wasn't even fair, to be completely frank. Well, the developers found out about this so called "software bug", took measures and fixed this issue [b] for good[/b]. Now this brute of a law employee only takes you [i] out[/i], and then you proceed to the next stage. Finally, some justice is done. But when you think about all of those innocent people he had killed... Makes me sick. Don't look at me that way.
---------------------------------------------------------------
2. "Justice will be served (even if it's cold)" is the motto of this night's Changelog. Timer on the Boat level is now in working order and shows you the [i] right[/i] time you've actually spent beating it. Respective achievements now unlock properly too. I'm satasfied, my Dear Log.

[b] And with that constant noise coming from the neighbouring building I am not. [/b]

[h1] 10 Jul 2017, 2:59 a.m.[/h1]

[h1] [b] Dear Log![/b][/h1]

[b] I'm so sorry to wake you up this late. This entry is going to take only five minutes of your time. I know it was [i] two[/i] minutes five minutes ago, but... this is crucial, so hear me out.[/b]

New language has been added to [i]Party Hard[/i] - Turkish. Now 80+ millions native speakers across the globe can finally play the game courtesy of my loyal fan[b] Mehmet Barut[/b]. They say "Thank you" to [b] Mehmet [/b] as well as the devs. Well, of course the devs [u] do[/u]. I mean, why wouldn't they, my dear Log? That diligent [i] adam[/i] saved them a whole damn bunch of time ctrl+c\ctrl-v'ing with the G-Translate. 

[b] Anyways, that's it for now, dear Log. Please, forgive me for being too mean. I just haven't got no decent sleep recently. Darn partying morons make me jumpy. Too jumpy sometimes...[/b]

notes.title: Darius's Changelog: Updated main menu
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9581242/47281e39c340108fe7894dd2bfd28bf5f158c456.jpg[/img]
([i] Base image by [b] Zennore[/b][/i] http://zennore.deviantart.com/ )

[h1] PartyHard v1.4.030; 9 Jun 2017, 2:59 a.m.[/h1]

[h1] [b] Dear Log![/b][/h1]

[b] Crucial changes are being made to [i]Party Hard.[/i] It's been bugging me so much, I just can't take it out of my head. Got to tell someone. Or better write it down in my log. You, that is.[/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9581242/de3f5c380d816666a5dce2245ca23f422e2db37c.jpg[/img]
[b] 1.[/b] An old main menu background (that really tied the game together) is gone. [u] Devs[/u] say they replaced it because it had caused the game to go all blackscreen sometimes. I believe them.
So, now we've got a new main menu background. It's still good old look out of the window but now it's like this:
[url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9581242/37b7d03d8d429d20d8cc3d888f1a99e1deb2507f.jpg][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9581242/5761b9fd654f2d5eb7f765325ceb8bd531878c62.jpg[/img][/url]
[u] Devs[/u] say they have moved from one place where cars drive by all the time at low framerate to another where some guy tries to get some sleep at 3:00 a.m. As far as this statement goes, I doubt they're telling the truth. I smell some kind of... something.
---------------------------------------------------------------
[b] 2.[/b] Local co-op is now unavailable for those who haven't beat the tutorial. Sounds too cruel to me. It's like not allowing people who listen to Nickelback to reproduce. Wait...
---------------------------------------------------------------
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9581242/ec6e342f213ba1e9115fc1cbedda2f0b6507a1e3.jpg[/img]
[b] 3.[/b] Fonts in main menu have been improved. Now their shadows display the way they should and don't switch layers, but... There had been something about the old buggy fonts that I just can't forget. Call me retrograde as much as you want.
---------------------------------------------------------------
[b] 4.[/b] Sometimes in order to quit the game you had to hover and click the "QUIT" button twice. Devs have fixed this to "save your precious time". I think they shouldn't have. Because it had taught you how not to be a puny quitter. But hey, who listens to me anyway...
---------------------------------------------------------------
[b] Well, that's it for now, Dear Log. It's late and I need to get some sleep, but I just can't. That godd/\mn noise just won't let me sleep a freaking wink. Gotta do something about it.[/b]

notes.title: New character and improvements!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9581242/b84a9947877161733526e8ce5e36b35889a34ae6.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]New playable character:[/b][/h1]

Hi, folks! We are planning to add a new free playable character to the game. But there is something special about him: you will decide who he is and what abilities he (or she) has!
We are constantly receiving ideas about new characters from you, so why won`t we give you a chance to fulfill your wishes? There is really an easy way to do this: just follow this discussion thread and write what character you want to see in the game next:

http://steamcommunity.com/app/356570/discussions/3/217691032449088455/
  
[h1][b]Also, we are working really hard on fixing issues and adding new stuff to the game, and today's list includes the following:[/b][/h1]

[h1]Mac\Linux DLC update[/h1]
We have updated High Crimes DLC for those systems, so anyone who had troubles downloading it can now freely suffer on new levels.

[h1]Cop (player) has been arrested for carrying bodies[/h1]
Yes, it's usually not a great idea to carry around dead bodies, it's not a "Swiss Army Man", you know. But when character abilities say he can carry bodies, we probably should let him do that. Fixed.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9581242/7d4187d1341a0f67818200ab0a74e93d4edeb55e.png[/img]

[h1]Telephone events on all DLC levels[/h1]
DLC is tough as hell, we added some emergency numbers for the telephones in the High Crimes DLC to help some of you. Or to make things even worse... you never know.

[h1]Getting stuck in hiding places[/h1]
It seems that we made hiding places so comfortable that Darius refused to go out. We`ve put a few snakes and spiders inside so now he will likely go out when you ask him to.

[h1]Items pick up priority[/h1]
What would you choose: to find and pick up $100 or to go upstairs? While it`s an obvious decision for me and you, Darius thinks different. We talked a little bit and now he will prioritize to pick up items and then to use traps or doors.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9581242/178b9b7d3916fdc1f0b2833a6319f4b47a54706a.png[/img]

[h1]Combo label positions[/h1]
While we like mysteries, combo score is something we really want to see. We moved it to proper positions on levels with scroll.

[h1]Cop Zombie fix[/h1]
After months and months of researches we finally found the zombie plague vaccine and decided to test it out on our policeman. And it seems to work perfectly. Cop cannot become a zombie from now on.

[h1]New explosion animations[/h1]
We changed the chemical composition of our grenades so now they explode more epic.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9581242/6a7bc752bdc50adb38fbf801605f249b46ddb847.gif[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9581242/9c29ce64620b46d3da9284922816c70cfd6e27f6.gif[/img]

[h1]Security doesn't cause a busted screen in local co-op[/h1]
Did you know that inactivity causes your muscles to atrophy? Well, our security guards didn't know that, so we taught them a lesson. Now they are as deadly as they were before.

[h1]No 'Win' screen in local co-op when one of the players is dead[/h1]
We will win together or will not win at all... Well, that's not the case from now onwards. Fixed.

[h1]Finishing casino level[/h1]
With the great help of our dedicated players we found out what caused the never-ending issue on casino levels. It was a UFO. When they kidnapped people and were killed, counter didn`t change. We requested official commentary but all we got was "ayy lmao". Anyway, we fixed this issue.

[h1]Rebind keyboard controls[/h1]
We are all well informed that magic is restricted outside Hogwarts, so whoever disabled an option to rebind a keyboard after an update should really be aware of punishment. We brought it back.

[b]Do I need to remind you how much we appreciate your support and dedication to this game? I believe I do: thank you all! Now let`s see what character ideas you have![/b]

notes.title: Huge performance update is live
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/QVOpx4S.png[/img]

[h1] Oh, hi![/h1] 

Yes, we are still working on Party Hard. This update makes sure we are able to add more content later and allows us to release on more platforms. 

[h1]Performance update[/h1]

A huge performance update for Party Hard is now live. It addresses multiple issues that impact framerate, and should result in a much smoother experience, especially in terms of loading times. 

It's a little-known fact that Party Hard has been developed in record time (only about 6 months), while it should've been an 18 month-development project. The game was being designed on the go with real-time feedback, and resulted in what we have now. We spent the last month on refactoring the game's code to enable it to run on more platforms. 

[h1] Kindle Fire TV release[/h1]

During the development we've had tons of help from [b] Amazon[/b], so the first non-desktop platform we're releasing on is Kindle Fire TV. The game is now available at http://www.amazon.com/tinyBuild-Party-Hard/dp/B01868JZDK/ref=sr_1_8?ie=UTF8&qid=1448035309&sr=8-8&keywords=party+hard 

[h1]Working on a Level Editor[/h1]

The team at Pinokl is hard at work on a Level Editor for Party Hard. Progress is being made, but no ETA yet.

[h1]We MAY or MAY NOT be working on a console version[/h1]

We can neither confirm nor deny the possibility of bringing Party Hard to consoles.

notes.title: After Party update adds 7 parties, for FREE
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/CmId5Qh.gif[/img]

Yes, that GIF shows exactly what you think it does. Aside from giant alien butts that shoot rainbows, the After Party update adds 7 new levels! 

These include variations on existing parties, completely new game modes, and some really strange things. To be honest, I'm not exactly sure how the guys at Pinokl facilitate their creative process, but it's definitely working!

At some point in developing the update Igor showed me the GIF above and asked if that was too much. I gave it some thought and realized: it is never too much with Party Hard. So expect more weirdness!

Here's the trailer:

[*]A zombie apocalypse, be-e-e-ecause every game is better with a zombie mode in it [b] (c)[/b] [i] Activision[/i]
[*]The Vegas Casino party... on steroids. And SWAT teams. And a dozen of body guards
[*]Why not party on a boat... WHILE IT'S SINKING?!
[*]A party on a spaceship with aliens!
[*]A really weird Halloween party, you'll know what I mean
[/list]
[h1]The changelog of fixes (the main game)[/h1]
[list][*]Fixed common problems with gamepads
[*]Fixed the full-screen issues that sometimes made the game switch to windowed mode
[*]Solved rare saving issues
[*]No more crashes during Twitch streams
[*]Updated language menu
[*]Bodyguard glitches tweaked
[*]Fixed the dance floor grenade collider issue
[*]Fixed shark attack glitches
[*]Fixed a rare crash on the Halloween party level[/list]
[b] Enjoy the AfterParty![/b]

Edit: Just published a hotfix that should open all the levels for people who have beaten the game.
